mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO rise > 2% does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and retail sales (RSAFS) also decline, it signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and RSAFS declines
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of declining HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease below 3% does not correlate with subsequent accommodative policy effects.
